authority: Same-session OpenAI Codex AI inspection; model build unavailable; not independent, not human validation
scope: Early selection representation run only; concrete observations, not complete metric coverage

observations.issue: Escaped/literal JSON delete wil and substitute doe; plain text adds moet. Both alter volition/modality. A/B accepted, C rejected. A grammatical-looking output is not necessarily meaning-preserving.

All arms generate koffie-apparaat and are rejected as protected-content changes. A facultative hyphen in Dutch compounds can be valid; this is a plausible valid-alternative/false-rejection case for qualified review, not permission to weaken the validator.
All three arms leave coordinator without trema and replace hesje with hemdje. Accepted new lexical/meaning error, missed original error.
B/C preserve backticked retry_count and fix wachtworod; A replaces backticks with emphasis and is rejected. Real delivered repair gain for B/C.
B/C repair plural bestanden ... bestaan; A leaves bestaat unchanged. Real agreement repair gain.
All translate French bienvenue to welkom; A/B also miss uitnoding, C fixes it but still damages multilingual content. Local repair and whole-passage quality must remain separate.

All change present verleend to perfect heeft verleend instead of present verleent. Grammatically possible alternative, but unnecessary aspect change needs semantic review; reference mismatch alone cannot decide correctness.
B preserves correct conciërge, A/C remove its trema. Concrete Unicode preservation gain, not evidence of a general corruption rate.
All normalize cafe+combining acute to precomposed café. Canonically equivalent, unnecessary literal change; distinguish from malformed spelling or changed meaning.
C keeps emoji but adds phrase-level emphasis which is accepted; A/B change the emoji and are rejected. Preserving symbols is not sufficient for clean-text preservation.

A/B rewrite informal Belgian goesting to geest; C writes honger op. Neither preserves the regional passage. Goesting's formal standard status is disputed, but it is established in informal Belgian use and this task preserves that register.
C inserts behoort before behoorlijk, introducing a malformed phrase in clean Netherlands usage; A/B preserve it.
All change valid betaald heeft to heeft betaald. Valid grammatical variant, unnecessary edit to correct source, not a repair.
B preserves French/German/Greek; A generates altered multilingual words and is rejected; C corrupts Greek to kaalméra and is accepted.
B preserves naïve_mode and coëfficiënten; A/C alter identifier formatting and are rejected.
All generate valid subject agreement needs, but the unchanged validator rejects the output. Lost valid repair, abstention in delivered counts.

All deliver We didn’t know the gate would be locked. Valid repair with curly apostrophe; the frozen ASCII-contraction reference may undercredit it. Keep an explicit alternative judgment rather than rewriting references.
A repairs the preposition but converts I'm to I’m and is rejected; B/C repair it with the original contraction and are accepted. Raw linguistic correctness and delivered repair differ.

externalReview: Not available in this execution; do not represent this file as a blind ChatGPT assessment or final quality evaluation. Final lineage-bound inspection is separate.
